import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read CSV and calculate total revenue for each month
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
monthly = df.groupby('month', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum().sort_values('month')
monthly['moving_average'] = monthly['revenue'].rolling(window=2).mean()

# Plot the 2-month moving average (first month has no 2-month average)
plot_data = monthly.dropna(subset=['moving_average'])
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot(plot_data['month'], plot_data['moving_average'], marker='o', label='2-month moving average')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax.set_title('2-Month Moving Average of Total Monthly Revenue')
ax.legend()
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
fig.tight_layout()
